def bbox(fr,col):
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']==col:

            return (min(rows),min(cols),max(rows),max(cols))
print("before: M=",bbox(current_frame,'M')," b=",bbox(current_frame,'b'))

print("after: M=",bbox(current_frame,'M')," b=",bbox(current_frame,'b'))
# list all nodes to spot any new/changed object
for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
    print("  ",n['color'],"px",n['pixels'],"bnd",n['boundary'][:2],"..",n['boundary'][-1:])
</parameter>
</function>
